scope: Bounded preparation for the existing voice recovery execution plan; runtime identity binding and one punctuation candidate on the existing configured speech route.

status.stage: The same reviewed diagnostic image was rearmed for one requested living-room observation. The preceding window expired without a capture; no physical success or acceptance is established.

runtimeBinding.processObservation: The existing observer can invoke a local callback at recording start and close. The helper reads only modules already present in that process's sys.modules; it does not import replicas to manufacture loaded-source evidence.
pinnedValues: Actual loaded source origin, source-file SHA256 and resident Python function-code digest
Process PID, process start ticks and Python version

runtimeBinding.publicSettings: Only fixed recognized speech engine/language/voice values and explicit boolean flags can be readable; other values remain digest-only.
runtimeBinding.comparison: Requires valid before/after process and container snapshots. Missing nested hashes, unreadable/unloaded sources, changed code/configuration/fixtures, restarted/replaced containers or a changed process invalidate the binding.
runtimeBinding.observerIntegration: Optional callback results are written to separate private 0600 before/after JSON files. Capture resumes retain the original recording deadline. A configured maximum of one recording can be used for the forthcoming supervised diagnostic.
runtimeBinding.failureBehavior: Identity capture failure invalidates measurement evidence without changing the live audio flow. Missing manifest files cannot count as valid comparison evidence.
limits: The caller must supply the required module set and the actual loaded/resolved configuration; this is not automatic completeness discovery.

In-process source evidence describes only the service process invoking the callback. Other services are bound by their explicitly observed container identity/configuration unless separately instrumented.
Resident function hashes do not describe every mutable global or authenticate user authority.
Matching snapshots establish the observed boundaries, not continuous attestation of every instant between them.
Runtime binding is not acoustic, DAC timing, physical interruption, speech-quality or owner-acceptance evidence.
runtimeBinding.integrationFinding: The configured native route imports speaker_livekit_audio, not speaker_audio. The default module set was corrected; a network-disabled smoke using actual ServiceConfig/provider construction and renderer startup produced a valid callback. This is interface validation, not live runtime binding.
runtimeBinding.completionBoundary: The final manifest is published only after WAV headers and buffered timing are closed. Both manifests use private complete temporary files and an atomic non-overwriting link.
runtimeBinding.dockerMountOrdering: Real Docker inspection returned identical Config/HostConfig and permuted Mounts. Only Mounts order is now canonicalized by complete mount JSON; every option is retained. The unnormalized guard stopped before installation; four actual inspection reads then matched after correction.

cadenceCandidate.change: Replace only Unicode U+2026 with U+002E in the existing TTS synthesis argument. Original approved core text and captions retain their punctuation; all words, other punctuation and character bounds remain unchanged.
cadenceCandidate.route: Existing configured Home Assistant cloud TTS, FennaNeural, decoded through HomeAssistantSpeechOutput and HomeAssistantTTS as 24 kHz mono PCM.
cadenceCandidate.liveProbeBinding: The fourth request imported the exact candidate file and applied its tts_punctuation helper to the original synthetic Unicode-ellipsis fixture, then used the installed HA adapter/decoder. It did not execute the complete candidate speak_literal output chain. The existing digital-silence filter was applied offline to the received PCM.
cadenceCandidate.quietMeasurement: Consecutive 10 ms windows with absolute sample peak at most 80; report runs of at least 100 ms. Leading and trailing runs are excluded from internal-pause counts. This is an operational PCM threshold, not exact phoneme timing.

attempts.scope: Mixed exploratory punctuation control: one ellipsis was normalized to a period plus space among ordinary sentences. This is not a matched before/after demonstration of identical natural speech.

cadenceCandidate.comparisonLimit: The period exploration and exact candidate have different received PCM hashes. They are separate requests, not byte-identical source recordings.
cadenceCandidate.supportedClaim: For this synthetic fixture, the exact punctuation helper yielded nine measured internal quiet intervals where the unchanged Unicode-ellipsis fixture yielded two. Providerless integration tests show one synthesis request for the short utterance, preserved caption text and unchanged text bounds.
notEstablished: Independent spoken-word fidelity: no ASR or physical listening was performed in these four probes.

A universal punctuation rule for other voices, ASCII ellipses or other text formats.
